newsitem.title: FRANCE: French teacher suspended over child porn probe.
newsitem.headline: French teacher suspended over child porn probe.

text.p: Education Minister Francois Bayrou has suspended a school teacher who is a suspect in a French child pornography scandal. Any other teachers implicated will immediately be dropped, the minister said on Friday.
The teacher, who is a school director in the central city of Orleans, is under investigation on suspicion of possessing pornographic cassettes featuring children.

Police have seized about 5,000 cassettes -- including one involving a six-month-old baby -- in a nationwide clampdown on paedophile videos begun on Wednesday. Thirty-six people, including the teacher, have been formally placed under investigation.

"Given the legitimate upset caused among children and families... the common sense response is that a person placed under investigation in these affairs must not have contact with students during the probe," Bayrou said.
"My duty is to protect children and take measures so that suspected teachers, if there are any, are immediately removed from contact with the students," Bayrou told Europe 1 radio.

Most of the suspects, who also include a social worker and a child day-care centre manager, were placed under investigation for "possession of pornographic material related to the sexual abuse of minors", police said.
Being placed under investigation under French law does not necessarily lead to a trial.
On Thursday, Prime Minister Alain Juppe launched a national campaign against child abuse, calling the fight against maltreatment of children a "great national cause".
France is now uncovering its own child sex scandals after watching revelations of paedophile murder and rape cases engulf neighbouring Belgium.
